t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two types of baskets in the game, red and green. The purple, red, and pink gnomes have the red baskets, and the blue, green, yellow and orange gnomes have the green baskets. Keep going with one colour category (either red or green baskets) if the mushroom yield is high (5+). When it starts to lower, e.g. less than five, switch to the other basket category.

vb_textbox.text: There are different coloured gnomes (pay attention to the hats) and each coloured gnome has either a red or yellow basket. Yellow basket: orange, blue, green, yellow gnomes. Red basket: brown, red, pink, purple gnomes. To be the most successful, I found that go for one basket at a time. For example, keep clicking yellow basket gnomes. This is until the mushroom yield begins to dwindle. When this happens (i.e. less that 5) switch to red basket gnomes. Keep going in this sequence. This isn't a perfect rule, but helps.
